name: Iterate
source: Hagisaka Shigetaka is 28 years old. His parents have already died. The only one in the world he can depend on is himself. Due to certain circumstances, a young woman named Shirayagi Aogi is living in his house.
translation: 萩坂重孝今年28岁，双亲已经去世。世上唯一能够依靠的人只有他自己。由于某些原因，一名叫白柳仰木的年轻女子正住在他家。
